title: Nonhomogeneous relational time: LQTA-D Article 3 pre-synthesis structural freeze
description: Version 2.1.0 scientific pre-synthesis archive of the LQTA-D nonhomogeneous relational-time branch. The archive preserves the closed homogeneous sector and common metrological calibration r0, refactors local rates r_i as derived representatives of the integrable CAL sector, and freezes the subsequent structural results: nonintegrable cycle memory, eta/Rho semantics, provenance-conditioned continuity, fixed-carrier update classification, bridge versus cycle-closing support changes, ancestor-anchored kappa defect algebra, restricted relative source results, and the final no-go showing that the frozen ontology does not select a unique autonomous CAL generator. This archive is not the Article 3 manuscript and does not claim energy, entropy, spatial flow, Lorentz structure, gravity, a continuum limit or autonomous dynamics.
